localChanges: TypeScript; functions over explicit state (space, stage, frame state) instead of `this` on the Danmaku instance; no DOM, no requestAnimationFrame (the Otter overlay layer drives frames).

Media time only: upstream places a running comment by wall-clock time since it entered (cmt._utc) times playbackRate; here x comes from the current media time minus the comment's time, so pause, rate and background need no state (ADR-012). Upstream's media-bound allocation already used media time.
Separate durations for scrolling and top / bottom comments (upstream: one duration = stage width / speed).
No room in the display area: the comment is dropped (B站 'no overlap'); upstream wraps the channel modulo the stage height and overlaps.
Seek / rebuild: the comments still in flight at the new time enter again mid-flight; upstream starts at the new time and drops them.
binsearch on `time` only; formatMode / raf / now / canvas helpers not copied.
